AI-generated voice detection.evidence: Achieved 0.8733 - 0.9026 ROC-AUC and up to 75.33% spoof recall on 13 genuinely unseen attack systems A07-A19 without in-training exposure.

Voice cloning detection.evidence: Model trained on 97 voice conversion (VCC) systems successfully detects unseen TTS and neural vocoder clones (A08, A09, A11, A14, A15 at 91%-100% recall).

Replay / spoof detection.evidence: Logical access synthetic audio is rigorously detected; physical acoustic replay through physical loudspeakers and room impulse responses was not tested.

Spectral / acoustic analysis.evidence: Two-channel feature extraction utilizes 60-bin Log-Mel Spectrogram + 60-bin Linear Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (LFCC) covering 80 Hz - 8,000 Hz.

Prosody analysis.evidence: The model relies strictly on short-term spectral envelope and cepstral harmonics (STFT frames); fundamental frequency (F0) tracking and syllable-level prosody features are not extracted.

Real-time processing.evidence: 3.0-second audio window is processed in ~13-15 ms full evaluation pipeline on CPU, yielding a real-time factor (RTF) of ~0.005, well below 1.0.

Low latency.evidence: Pure neural forward pass requires only 6.57 ms on an Intel Core i5 CPU.

ASR (Speech-to-Text).evidence: No speech recognition engine was evaluated or benchmarked in this acoustic deepfake pipeline.

Sensitive-data detection.evidence: Detection of sensitive credentials (OTP, Aadhaar, PAN) requires transcript text from ASR; acoustic models do not process lexical semantics.

Social-engineering detection.evidence: Scam pattern analysis and conversational urgency analysis operate on text/dialogue, not acoustic waveforms.

Multilingual / Indian-language robustnes.evidence: All evaluated datasets (ASVspoof, VCC) are English-language speech; Indic phonetic robustness has not been tested.

Enterprise / banking integration.evidence: Standard telephony G.711 A-law/mu-law codec robustness was verified, but PBX/SIP telephony trunk integration and production concurrency were not tested.

scorecard.evidence: Zero attack system overlap; A07-A19 evaluated frozen.
Evaluated on 6 conditions; G.711 A-law/mu-law augmentation improves F1 by ~10 pp.
Validation-derived thresholds tested on held-out test set (Policy B & C evaluated).
6.57 ms forward pass on Intel Core i5-1235U CPU.
Model classifies spoof vs bona-fide, does not perform 1:1 speaker biometric enrollment.
No transcription engine evaluated in Phase 1/2.
Research prototype validated; concurrency, packaging, and UI deployment remain.

what_is_proven: A compact 93,442-parameter MiniAcousticCNN can run efficiently on standard laptop CPUs (6.57 ms forward pass).
Source-disjoint partitioning (training on VCC2020/2018, evaluating on ASVspoof A07-A19) establishes genuine unseen-generator generalization without data leakage.
Channel-augmented training (2x balanced set) prevents model collapse under G.711 telephony and additive noise, improving telephony F1 by ~10 percentage points.
Validation-derived threshold calibration successfully transfers false-positive suppression to clean wideband audio (FPR reduced to 3.33% under Policy C, 2.00% under Policy B).
No single fixed threshold simultaneously provides maximal spoof recall (>80%) and ultra-low false alarms (<5%) across both clean audio and telephony channels.
what_is_not_proven: Commercial voice-cloner robustness (ElevenLabs, OpenAI Voice Engine, Cartesia, PlayHT).
Arbitrary unseen neural vocoders beyond the 13 academic systems in ASVspoof 2019.
Indian-language, accent, or multilingual robustness (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, etc.).
Real in-the-wild cellular/PSTN telephone network carrier jitter and packet loss.
Uncontrolled ambient background noise outside the synthetic 15 dB Gaussian model.
Physical acoustic replay attacks through physical loudspeakers and room reverberation.
Production-scale concurrent stream handling and latency under multi-tenant load.
End-to-end user experience and mobile application integration.
Guaranteed security-grade or legal evidentiary certainty.
